races.paceDynamic: Seeyouinmydreams will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the outset, with Demoiselle Kap and Mr Globalist likely to sit handy in behind. With only one natural front runner in a small field, Seeyouinmydreams can dictate terms without pressure, setting sustainable fractions over this 2m trip. The hold-up horses Starman, Palm Beach and Bray Dale will need the pace to be strong enough to create gaps, but with Seeyouinmydreams unlikely to be pressed early, they face a tactical disadvantage. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and challenge turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Seeyouinmydreams Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Seeyouinmydreams jumps well and dictates comfortable fractions without early pressure.
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner can use his class edge to quicken off steady gallop, leaving hold-up horses with too much to do. Demoiselle Kap benefits from tracking the winner but may lack the finishing kick to get past.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Demoiselle Kap or Mr Globalist press Seeyouinmydreams early, creating stronger gallop.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up the race for closers, with Seeyouinmydreams potentially vulnerable to late challenges. Starman's hold-up style becomes an asset as the pace collapses in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Seeyouinmydreams Falters
scenarios.trigger: If the long absence or jumping errors compromise Seeyouinmydreams' dominance.
scenarios.body: Demoiselle Kap inherits the lead and her consistent recent form tells, while the race develops into a battle between the prominent runners. Mr Globalist stays on for minor honours but lacks the class to win.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closer's Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If amateur jockeys or tactical errors create unusually strong early gallop.
scenarios.body: The sustained pace plays perfectly into the hands of the hold-up horses, with Palm Beach's recent win giving confidence. Bray Dale could also benefit from the collapse up front despite inconsistent recent form.

races.paceDynamic: Blue Skies Ahead will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, likely getting an uncontested lead through the early stages. With seven hold-up horses and no prominent racers to apply pressure, Blue Skies Ahead can dictate a steady, sustainable gallop that suits his style perfectly. The lack of pace pressure means the leaders will have every chance to stay on, while the massed ranks of hold-up horses face a tactical nightmare trying to get into the race from similar positions. This race shape strongly favours the leader and any horse that can race prominently early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Blue Skies Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Skies Ahead gets the easy lead he's likely to receive
scenarios.body: He can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back up the hill, especially with his recent Hexham win giving him course confidence. The hold-up brigade will struggle to make up ground against a horse who's had everything his own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and Blue Skies Ahead stops in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The strong travellers among the hold-up horses can pick him off late, with Earnest Belief and Masekela having the best tactical speed. Their ability to quicken off a steady pace becomes the decisive factor.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Staying Power Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the good ground and 2m trip becomes a genuine stamina test
scenarios.body: The older, more experienced horses like Just Keeps Rolling and Masekela can grind out victory through superior fitness. Blue Skies Ahead may weaken after setting the pace but the younger horses lack the engine.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the tactical nature of the race
scenarios.body: Terrano or one of the lesser-fancied runners capitalises on a messy finish where positioning proves crucial. The lack of early pace allows an outsider to steal a march approaching the final flight.

With no pace pressure on Crackerjacque early, this creates a scenario where the pace may not be strong enough to set up the race for Sonigino coming from behind. races.paceDynamic: William Of York will likely set the early gallop with multiple prominent runners including Wee Alki, Stylish Recruit, It's Maisy and Dillarchie all keen to race handy. This creates a competitive early pace over the extended trip, with the prominent brigade likely to string out the field. The sustained tempo should set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to finish strongly, particularly those with proven stamina. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can capitalize on the early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain a solid gallop and string the field out as expected
scenarios.body: The sustained pace plays into the hands of patient riders who can produce their charges late with one decisive move. Hold-up specialists with proven stamina will have the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Succeed
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy horses can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear
scenarios.body: A horse like Stylish Recruit or It's Maisy could steal a march by getting first run on the field before the hold-up horses get organized. The winner would need to be tough enough to repel late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If William Of York goes too slow and the prominent runners fail to create genuine tempo
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any running style can prevail, favoring horses with the best recent form regardless of tactics. Fresh legs and class become the deciding factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace War Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage in an early speed duel and go too fast
scenarios.body: The early leaders burn each other out completely, allowing a mid-division runner to emerge from the pack. Only horses that avoid the early skirmish entirely will have energy left.

watchPoints.text: William Of York must prove his fitness after 41 days off - if he goes too slow early the race dynamic completely changes
Multiple prominent runners including Wee Alki, Stylish Recruit and It's Maisy could engage in pace warfare that sets up the hold-up horses perfectly
East Eagle and Belladinotte both carry 3lb and 5lb claiming apprentices respectively which significantly reduces their burden in a competitive handicap
Dusky Days returns from 252 days off with excellent course form but fitness must be questionable after such a long absence
The Bewley family combination of Robert d'Ores could be value given their intimate course knowledge despite recent poor trainer form
